name: howto
title: Your first Instant Pot run, in six steps
sub: The water test and release methods from Instant Pot's own guidance
footer: Source: Instant Pot test-run and FAQ pages (summaries, October 2026); follow your model's manual where it differs.

items.head: Check the ring
items.body: Silicone ring seated flat in the lid, rim clean, pot dry.

items.head: Add 3 cups of water
items.body: Inner pot in the base, lid closed, valve on Sealing.

items.head: Pressure cook 5 minutes
items.body: Manual or Pressure Cook. The timer starts after pressure builds.

items.head: Quick release
items.body: Move the valve to Venting when it beeps. Wait for the float valve to drop.

items.head: Respect the fill lines
items.body: Never past 2/3; only to 1/2 for rice, beans and foods that expand.

items.head: Add thin liquid
items.body: At least 1 to 1½ cups for a 6-quart; thick sauces do not count.
